_about: Hand-labelled headlines for the news classifier. Most are real rows stored on 2026-10-15 (Livemint, MarketWatch, FT and Fed) or items from the feeds tested that day (CNBC, Guardian, CNA, ET, FXStreet, DW). Labels are a reader's judgement of the headline, not the classifier's output; the tests assert an agreement rate, plus exact results for the grill report's regression examples (marked regression: true).
